title: #6186 Fixes the flowchart node metadata syntax bugs
body:
This pull request includes changes to improve the flowchart parser and add new syntax support for node metadata in the Mermaid library. The most important changes include switching from a `.jison` parser to a TypeScript parser, adding tests for the new syntax, and updating the parser to handle specific edge cases.

### Parser Improvements:
* Replaced `flow.jison` with `flowParser.ts` across multiple test files to transition to a TypeScript-based parser. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-6ca7bf4a3ea62a5f1474f5fda60ce169bcfb380a6488ee596b23cffba6c40975L6-R7) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-af6b24e8e1ffada0712e0cbd59926a162b3aad36042b39f9875dc654660055b9L2-R2) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-a11fed56f6e91148dd586f9ecc3fc3976b6a046bfb10c059e983c105de6b3808L2-R2) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-802e6e254045b1eddfcb5f64792cbbd87521c53303eaacac4a31f6f7e502c30cL2-R2) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-af9c5a34b097c1427bcf0d5613c8e623084e5fcaac37dac60df9a5964329c2bdL2-R2) [[6]](diffhunk://#diff-8b45db3ff2f717aefcaa33a3fb8382a579a0861ebeada948e45f2a4b29be69e3L2-R2) [[7]](diffhunk://#diff-0e73a70a7c776bc97aa3f2180927fc42e5fa0441019d4a21c0380a480d797129L2-R2) [[8]](diffhunk://#diff-c0480ce146dd852999f236e0afd0afaf16e4fe180ed07ca599056a9943e0e741L2-R2) [[9]](diffhunk://#diff-26852c91087c3b06e7883b1ecf200b25c61b4fe63efa87867b4612ae3fe18828L2-R2) [[10]](diffhunk://#diff-4e04d054b8312996bfa033b3295ec7191570a4fef8ee28dd5d4d85331955f045L2-R2) [[11]](diffhunk://#diff-1a7746dff4bfc410b380bf1c3750f23fd4edcd23454064bdc4b4eaf6026ac1edL2-R2) [[12]](diffhunk://#diff-5253ba5853f042567c72d3b31efd4c6f9e57a0b91568978a35746e5c0f28f6a8L2-R2) [[13]](diffhunk://#diff-5b92104df7dddc2b2ae8c6c9b058c8440e6ecc24593aff413f81f40bed5d6245L2-R2) [[14]](diffhunk://#diff-707f63af9eec84f29f1e510b5c1a36187f2bcb96e0465873ca9723f34500839dL2-R2) [[15]](diffhunk://#diff-190c25219d0c813c4454c1e7de60d36ca9995a77ff831ca53ec313a747d234b1L2-R2) [[16]](diffhunk://#diff-2f4ca949bbcc64b64333ae19b9f564340393bff6ed12b0e827fec2156e01ce02L2-R2)
* Created `flowParser.ts` to wrap the existing JISON parser and handle trailing whitespace after closing curly braces.

### New Syntax Support:
* Added support for `@` syntax to add labels on multiple nodes and handle edge cases with trailing spaces and `&`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-d1dc4a0713887ed7a0940ce022746f69b73d10c4e0a6979fa6a16fb6f15bdb89R1-R8) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-c496530fa45816d603f73358c33be87869deb0563f89b32c889507f94e26d1a9R1079-R1106) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-4e04d054b8312996bfa033b3295ec7191570a4fef8ee28dd5d4d85331955f045R293-R316)

### Bug Fixes:
* Fixed incorrect label mapping for nodes when using `&`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-0d402731a094263cd9703f40974d74949df8b287c03dc68f47c317a6ec8a35dcL410-R410) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-0d402731a094263cd9703f40974d74949df8b287c03dc68f47c317a6ec8a35dcL419-R419)
